evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies wallet descriptor import and keypool refill logic in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/wallet/imports.cpp.
rationale: Fixes node aborts and signed integer overflows triggered during keypool refill and descriptor imports with boundary ranges. Multiple reviewers reproduced crashes on master when importing descriptors ending at 2^31-1 or running keypool refill under edge-case bounds.
